{
  "dataset_name": "pima_diabetes",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "glucose_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Z-score normalized plasma glucose concentration using training set mean and std, clipped to [-4, 4] for SVM margin stability",
      "value_range": [-4.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "glucose_metabolism",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Directly normalized glucose is the strongest linear predictor for diabetes; z-scoring centers the SVM hyperplane",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((plas - 120.89) / 31.95, -4.0, 4.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "bmi_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Z-score normalized BMI using training set statistics, clipped for outlier robustness",
      "value_range": [-4.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "body_composition",
      "expected_model_benefit": "BMI is a key diabetes risk factor; normalization ensures equal contribution in linear SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((mass - 31.99) / 7.88, -4.0, 4.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "age_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Z-score normalized age using training set statistics",
      "value_range": [-4.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "demographics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Age is a continuous risk factor; normalization aligns scale with other features for SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((age - 33.24) / 11.75, -4.0, 4.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "diabetes_pedigree_log",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed diabetes pedigree function to reduce right skew, then normalized",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "genetic_risk",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Log transform reduces skewness of pedigree distribution, improving linear separability",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((np.log1p(pedi) - np.log1p(0.4719)) / 0.28, -3.0, 3.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "glucose_bmi_composite",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted composite of normalized glucose and BMI, approximating a linear projection of two key diabetes risk factors",
      "value_range": [-4.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "metabolic_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Combines two strongest predictors into a single composite score that approximates the dominant linear discriminant direction",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(0.6 * ((plas - 120.89) / 31.95) + 0.4 * ((mass - 31.99) / 7.88), -4.0, 4.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "insulin_log_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed and normalized insulin level to handle extreme right skew",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "glucose_metabolism",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Insulin has high variance and skew; log transform makes it more linearly useful for SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((np.log1p(insu) - np.log1p(79.8)) / 1.5, -2.0, 4.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "pregnancies_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalized pregnancy count using training statistics, clipped for outlier robustness",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "demographics",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Number of pregnancies correlates with diabetes risk; normalization ensures proper SVM scaling",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((preg - 3.845) / 3.367, -2.0, 4.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "glucose_to_bmi_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of plasma glucose to BMI, capturing metabolic efficiency; log-transformed and normalized",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "metabolic_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Ratio captures interaction between glucose and body composition; useful linear feature for SVM margin",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((np.log1p(plas) - np.log1p(np.maximum(mass, 0.1)) - 1.5) / 0.5, -3.0, 3.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "skin_thickness_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Normalized triceps skin fold thickness, a proxy for body fat percentage",
      "value_range": [-2.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "body_composition",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Skin thickness correlates with insulin resistance; normalization enables linear contribution",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((skin - 20.54) / 15.94, -2.0, 5.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "blood_pressure_deviation",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Absolute deviation of diastolic blood pressure from population mean, normalized; captures hypertension risk",
      "value_range": [0.0, 4.0],
      "feature_family": "cardiovascular",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Deviation from normal blood pressure is a risk indicator; absolute deviation is a smooth continuous feature",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(np.abs(pres - 69.11) / 19.34, 0.0, 4.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "metabolic_risk_severity",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Holistic metabolic risk severity score combining glucose level, BMI category, age, and insulin resistance signals into a continuous 0-10 scale. Score 0-3: low risk profile with normal glucose, healthy BMI, younger age. Score 4-6: moderate risk with borderline values in one or more factors. Score 7-10: high risk with elevated glucose (>140), obese BMI (>30), older age (>45), or multiple compounding factors.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "metabolic_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a semantically grounded composite risk score that captures non-linear interactions between metabolic factors in a single continuous feature useful for SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "insulin_glucose_balance_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Assessment of insulin-glucose homeostasis balance on a continuous 0-10 scale. Score 0-3: well-balanced with low glucose and proportionate insulin. Score 4-6: mild imbalance with elevated glucose or abnormal insulin-to-glucose ratio. Score 7-10: severe imbalance indicating likely insulin resistance or deficiency, characterized by high glucose with low insulin or extreme insulin values.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "glucose_metabolism",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures the physiological relationship between insulin and glucose that is central to diabetes diagnosis; provides a smooth continuous score for linear SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
